text:
Fixed the generator loop length off-by-one bug.

Root cause: when `loop.last` or `loop.nextitem` had prefetched an item, the length calculation consumed the remaining iterator without counting that cached item.

Updated both synchronous and asynchronous loop contexts to include the prefetched item in the calculated length. Relevant tests pass: 82 passed.

final_text:
Fixed the generator loop length off-by-one bug.

Root cause: when `loop.last` or `loop.nextitem` had prefetched an item, the length calculation consumed the remaining iterator without counting that cached item.

Updated both synchronous and asynchronous loop contexts to include the prefetched item in the calculated length. Relevant tests pass: 82 passed.
